newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares end higher in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares end higher in continuous trade.

text.p: Six stocks rose, one fell and three were flat in Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Thursday.
Turnover fell to 0.9 million zlotys from 2.6 million zlotys on Wednesday.
NFI units rose 4.6 percent to 137.5 zlotys in a 16.1-million-zloty turnover.
The continuous trading system, which currently lists 15 companies, is separate from the bourse's main single-price auction system in which the same firms and 65 others are traded.
At the single-price auction session most stocks fell and the main market's index fell 1.1 percent.
